# ramble_organization (Data Source)

Look up an organisation in a Ramble registry by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ramble_organization" "platform" {
  name = "platform-team"
}

output "platform_member_count" {
  value = data.ramble_organization.platform.member_count
}

# Null when the token's user is not a member of the organisation.
output "platform_owners" {
  value = [
    for m in coalesce(data.ramble_organization.platform.members, []) : m.username if m.role == "owner"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the organisation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `description` (String) Short description.
- `id` (String) The name of the organisation as Ramble stores it.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of members.
- `members` (Attributes List) The members, sorted by username. Ramble lists members only to its own members, so this is `null` when the token's user is not a member of the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `role` (String) Either `owner` or `member`.
- `username` (String) Username of the member.
